title: The recap
caption: The same timeline with one discipline lit, to say where a demo sits.

readme.heading: Read me
readme.shows: The timeline with Workflows lit and the other disciplines dimmed, every scene at rest.
readme.tryit: Move the mouse onto another column: it lights and plays while the mouse stays. Move away and Workflows is lit again.
readme.notice: The lit discipline comes from the Preset, so a Slide recaps a discipline without any state of its own.

recap.header: A recap without state of its own
recap.description: The recap Preset lights Workflows, so a Slide later in an Episode can say where a demo sits on the timeline. The intro Episode of the CyberForum webinar uses it after its third check-in.
